parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client for each request. The \`ClientToken\` parameter supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request is different.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: Sends a check request without modifying service resources.

- **false** (default): Sends a normal request.

parameters.name: EcrId
parameters.description: The ID of the ECR instance.

parameters.name: EcrOwnerAliUid
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the ECR instance belongs.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: InstanceRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the network instance whose authorization you want to revoke.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **VBR**: a VBR instance.

- **VPC**: a VPC instance.
